revisions.reason: Review 20261127 palette detach: synchronous indexed presentation refresh discards decoded palette tuples and nearest-index cache when the current canonical palette pointer/count is empty. It then uses the existing unbound pixel-format fallback, exactly as a fresh surface does. No callback, guest reference, owner, continuation, scheduling or restoration boundary is introduced or moved. Canonical DirectDraw palette attachment AddRef/Release ownership remains unchanged. Public COM Lock/Unlock, SetPalette, GetPalette and Release regression proves literal RGBA after detach and rebind, shared lifetime after caller Release and unchanged index storage; run 20261127-palette-rebind-gameplay-root. General invocation ownership remains pending.
